headline: Rakuten Viki’s K-Drama Day Returns For The Fourth Year: Celebrate With Free Shows, Special Prizes, Talent Exclusives, And More
summary: Rakuten Viki has launched its fourth annual K-Drama Day, running from September 25 through October 1 with free shows, prizes, and exclusive content.

headline: xikers Reveals Comeback Date With Teaser For “ROUTE ZERO : The CALLING”
summary: Boy group xikers announced their upcoming return by releasing a teaser for their eighth mini-album, "ROUTE ZERO : The CALLING."

headline: Watch: CRAVITY Announces Comeback With Teaser For New EP “sonorous”
summary: K-pop group CRAVITY announced their upcoming comeback by releasing a teaser video for their new mini album, "sonorous," set to drop on September 30.

headline: Watch: ENHYPEN Takes 7th Win And Triple Crown For “Bloody Paradise” On “M Countdown”; Performances By EVAN, &TEAM, And More
summary: ENHYPEN secured their seventh music show win and a triple crown for "Bloody Paradise" on the September 10 episode of "M Countdown."

headline: Jung Min Ah And Dong Ha’s Lives Collide Over Fashion And A Hidden Family Secret In “Mission: Mompossible”
summary: The new daily drama "Mission: Mompossible" released a poster previewing the intertwined lives and hidden family secrets of two vastly different mothers and their children.

headline: France Unveils Shortlist of Five Films for the International Oscar Race, From ‘Minotaur’ to ‘De Gaulle’ and ‘Iron Boy’
summary: France announced a five-film shortlist featuring "Minotaur" and "The Battle of De Gaulle" to represent the nation in the international Oscar race.

headline: Paul Walker’s Brother Says AI Could Bring Actor Back for Final ‘Fast and Furious’ Movie but ‘I Would Not Be Interested in Doing That’
summary: Paul Walker’s brother rejected the idea of using artificial intelligence to resurrect the late actor's character for the final "Fast and Furious" film.

headline: ‘Hawaii Five-O’ Movie in the Works From ‘Spider-Man: Brand New Day’ Director Destin Daniel Cretton
summary: Paramount is developing a "Hawaii Five-O" feature film directed by Destin Daniel Cretton and written by Chris Bremner.

headline: Andrew Scott to Receive Mill Valley Film Festival’s Acting Award for ‘Elsinore’ (EXCLUSIVE)
summary: Andrew Scott will receive the Mill Valley Film Festival’s Acting Award for his starring role in the upcoming drama "Elsinore."

headline: Gaza Doc ‘NAZA,’ From ‘No Other Land’ Directors, Earns Record-Breaking 24.5-Minute Venice Ovation as Producer Jonathan Glazer Leads Applause
summary: The Gaza documentary “NAZA” broke Venice Film Festival records with a massive 24.5-minute standing ovation led by producer Jonathan Glazer.
